# A coarse-mesh estimate of secondary-vortex response, pending refinement

The instrument approximated the hypothesized trend on a coarse mesh; survivors require downstream confirmation.

## Background

Spectral benchmarks provide the reference secondary-vortex intensities [R2].

## Hypothesis

Secondary-vortex intensity responds measurably to the lid-speed sweep.

## Experiment Design

A lid-speed sweep on the requested (coarse) mesh resolution.

## Results

A QoI shift was observed, flagged refine: survivors require downstream confirmation.

## Discussion

The trend is suggestive but unconfirmed at this resolution.

## What Humans Must Validate

- The volAverage(mag(U)) shift across the sweep must be confirmed at finer mesh resolution before the trend is trusted.
